A vessel bigger than a

I don't really feel like it...

I know I'm not much... but...
would you... be my friend?

No matter what I do, it doesn't work...
No matter what I do, it doesn't work...
No matter what I do, it doesn't work...
No matter what I do, it doesn't work...

Translated Text:
Man, you've got me beat...
I'll admit you're strong...
Starting today, we're friends...
all the way to the afterlife...

Original Text: はぁ　【負：ま】けてしまった…
オレっちの【出番：でばん】ニャン！
ガンガン【行：い】くニャン！
Translated Text: Let's go full steam ahead, meow!

Translated Text: I'm just not feeling it today, meow...

Original Text: しびれるおふだで　すばやさがダウン

Translated Text:
You're pretty good, meow! Let's be
friends, meow!

Wanna be friends with me, an S-class guy?

You're so strong, meow~. I'd
be happy to be friends with
you, meow!

This is such a pain, meow…

Translated Text: He gets angry and ends up attacking a nearby Yo-kai.
Got a problem with that, meow!?

Original Text: オレとお【前：まえ】は【今日：きょう】からマブダチニャ！\n【夜：よ】　【露：ろ】　【死：し】　【苦：く】！
Translated Text:
You and I are best buddies starting today!
Yoru-ro-shi-ku!

Original Text: サーチ【完了：かんりょう】！
【未来：みらい】では【当然：とうぜん】のこと！
Translated Text: It'll be a given in the future!

Original Text: 【私：わたし】に【不可能：ふかのう】はない！
【鋼鉄：こうてつ】パワーで　まもりがアップ

きみのような【武将妖怪：ぶしょうようかい】に【出会：であ】えるとは！\n【未来：みらい】からきたかいがあったようだ！
Translated Text:
I can't believe I've actually
met a warrior Yo-kai like you!
It looks like coming from the
future was worth it after all!

Original Text: 【黄金：おうごん】パワーで　まもりが【大：だい】アップ
Translated Text: Golden Power: Defense Gets a Huge Boost

Original Text: 【私：わたし】は　ゴルニャン！\nプライスレスな【輝：かがや】きをきみに！
Translated Text:
I'm Goryan! Here's a
priceless sparkle just for you!

Original Text: すばらしい【面構：つらがま】えだニャン。\nオレと　ともだちになろうニャン！

You've got a great face,
meow. Let's be friends, meow!

【美：うつく】しきブルーニャン！

Original Text: きみのこと【気：き】に【入：い】ったニャン。\nともだちになってあげるニャン！

I like you, meow. I'll be your
friend, meow!

Original Text: かがやくグリーンニャン！
からだが【重：おも】いニャン…
エメラルドのかがやきで　【全：ぜん】ステータスがアップ
Translated Text: All stats are boosted by the emerald's glow

Original Text: きみすごいニャン！　【感動：かんどう】したニャン！\nともだちになるしかないニャン！
Translated Text:
You're amazing, meow! I'm so
moved, meow! We've got to be
friends, meow!

Original Text: じょうねつの【赤：あか】ニャン！
ルビーのかがやきで　【全：ぜん】ステータスがアップ
Translated Text: All stats increase with the Ruby's glow

Original Text: 【燃：も】えてきたニャ！\nともだちになってやるニャ！
Translated Text:
I'm fired up, meow! I'll be your
friend, meow!

【友情：ゆうじょう】パワーニャン！
【戦：たたか】いたくないニャン…
Translated Text: I don't want to fight, meow...

Original Text: トパーズのかがやきで　【全：ぜん】ステータスがアップ
Translated Text: All stats are boosted by the Topaz's radiance

Original Text: そろそろ　ともだちになってもいい。\nそんな【気：き】がしたニャ！
Translated Text:
I think it's about time we became friends.
That's what I felt, meow!
I just can't seem to muster the strength...

Original Text: お【皿：さら】がカラカラっス…

You're pretty good, man.

この【刀：かたな】で…　【斬：き】る！

Want to be friends?

Translated Text: You'll get burned by Komasan's eyebrows

Hey, I've become an S... Will you be my

A Hairpiece That Makes You a Hit with the Ladies!

Starting today, we're friends.

Translated Text: With Tora Tora Power, your speed gets a huge boost

Phew! Losing really sucks!
I guess I'll just have to be
friends with him, then.

Uh... um... uh... w... would you... be my
friend...?

Translated Text: It's... so cold... Would you be my\nfriend and keep me warm...?
It's so cold I can't move...

Translated Text: Behold the power of the Snow Prince!

Translated Text: My body is numb, and my speed has dropped significantly.

【見事：みごと】な【戦：たたか】いだったぞ！\nお【前：まえ】とならともだちになってもいいな！
Translated Text:
That was an amazing fight!
I'd be happy to be friends with you!

Original Text: 【燃：も】える【心：こころ】で　ちからがアップ

Translated Text:
That was one intense battle!
You and I are bound by a
strong bond of friendship!

Original Text: ボ…　ボクが【行：い】くぞう
おしっこが　もれそうになる
Translated Text: I feel like I'm about to pee myself
It looks like it's about to spill...

Translated Text:
I... I feel like I'm about
to cry... but I want to be
friends with you...

Original Text: まだ　がまんできる…
おしっこが　もれそうになる
Translated Text: I feel like I'm about to pee myself

Original Text: 【早：はや】くともだちになってぇ～！\nもれちゃうよ～…　プルプル…。
Translated Text:
Let's be friends soon~!
I'm gonna spill~… *shiver shiver*…

Translated Text: Let's just take it as it comes!

Translated Text: Thanks to the monk's protection, HP gradually recovers

Original Text: なんだか【気分：きぶん】いいぞ！
なかなかいい　【運：うん】をもってるようじゃの！\nわしと　ともだちにならんか？
Translated Text:
Looks like you've got
some pretty good luck!
How about becoming friends with me?

Original Text: 【吉：きち】と【出：で】るか　【凶：きょう】と【出：で】るか…
Translated Text: Will it turn out for the best or for the worst…

Translated Text: I've got a bad feeling about this...
I guess it might not work out…

I can't believe I did that...

Translated Text:
You've got quite a nice
face, don't you? That's
good. I'll be your friend.
I'm going to wipe them out.
I wonder if I've caught a cold...

Original Text: 【調子：ちょうし】が【出：で】ないな…
Translated Text: I just can't seem to get into the swing of things...

Original Text: やけどして　ＨＰがだんだん【減：へ】っていく
Translated Text: I get burned, and my HP gradually decreases.

Original Text: 【貴様：きさま】　【強：つよ】い【意志：いし】を【持：も】っておるな。\nオレを【連：つ】れて【行：い】くがよいぞ。
Translated Text:
You've got some strong willpower,
don't you? Go ahead and take
me with you.

Translated Text:
Want to be friends?
I'm shiny and delicious!

Original Text: おなかがすいて　ちからが【大：だい】ダウン
Translated Text: I'm hungry, and my energy is way down.
I wonder if there's anything to eat.

Translated Text:
You look pretty tasty,
don't you…? I think I'll just

Original Text: 【黄泉：よみ】の【呪：のろ】いで　ようりょくが【大：だい】ダウン
Translated Text: The Curse of the Underworld Causes a Major Drop in Stamina
Is it okay if I read this book…?

Original Text: きみと　ともだちになって　いっしょに\n【本：ほん】を【読：よ】むのもいいかも…。　そう【思：おも】った…。
Translated Text: It might be nice to become\nfriends with you and read books\ntogether… That’s what I thought…
You're not a decoy, are you?

Original Text: オレ　【信頼：しんらい】されてるよな？
オレ【仲間：なかま】だよな？　な？
Translated Text: I'm one of the gang, right? Right?

Original Text: オレを【見捨：みす】てるのか…？
Translated Text: Are you going to abandon me…?

Original Text: だれも【信：しん】じられない…
【疑：うたが】い【深：ぶか】くなって　【手当：てあ】たりしだいこうげきする
Translated Text: They become suspicious and attack everything in sight.

Original Text: だれも【信用：しんよう】しない！
だれも【信用：しんよう】できん！
だれも【信用：しんよう】できん！
だれも【信用：しんよう】しないニャ！
もう　【信：しん】じられない…
きみ【強：つよ】いから　ともだちになってみるか？\nう…　【裏切：うらぎ】るなよ！？
Translated Text:
You're strong, so... wanna be friends?
Uh... don't betray me, okay!?

Original Text: もう　【信：しん】じないからな！
Translated Text: I'm not falling for that again!
This is a piece of cake!

Original Text: やだ！　【戦：たたか】いたくない！
Translated Text: No way! I don't want to fight!

Original Text: だだをこねて　【近：ちか】くの【妖怪：ようかい】にやつあたりする
Translated Text: Throwing a tantrum and taking it out on a nearby Yo-kai
I'm getting sick of this, meow!

Original Text: けっ！　【負：ま】けたのは【本気：ほんき】だしてねぇからだ！\nでも！　まあ　ともだちになってもいいぜ！
Translated Text:
Pfft! I lost because I didn't give it my all!
But! Well, I guess I'm cool
with us being friends!

Original Text: 【本気出：ほんきだ】してねぇから！
【戦：たたか】いたくなんかねーよ！
Translated Text: I don't want to fight at all!

Original Text: 【調子悪：ちょうしわる】くねーよ！
Translated Text: I'm not feeling bad at all!

Original Text: ひねくれて　【近：ちか】くの【妖怪：ようかい】にやつあたりする
Translated Text: Feeling grumpy, he takes it out on a nearby Yo-kai.

Original Text: かき【回：まわ】してあげる…
Translated Text: I'll stir it up for you…
I'm counting on you from here on out~

Original Text: お【前：まえ】となんか【絶対：ぜったい】ともだちになんねえよ！\nバーカ　バーカ。
Translated Text:
There's no way I'm ever
going to be friends with you!
You idiot, you idiot.

Original Text: び　ビビってねぇし
まじ　ビビッてねぇし！
Translated Text: Seriously, I'm not scared at all!

Original Text: ビビってんじゃねーよ！
ビビらせんじゃねえよ…
びびって　【行動：こうどう】できなくなる
Translated Text: I get so scared that I can't bring myself to act
I'm starting to get scared, meow...

Original Text: ビ　ビビってねーし！
ビビったー！　まじビビった―！\n【強：つよ】すぎるぜ！　どうしてくれんだよ！
Translated Text:
I was so freaked out! Seriously,
I was totally freaked out!
That's way too strong!
What am I supposed to do?!

Original Text: び　ビビってねーし！
チビってんじゃねえぞ？

Translated Text: That gave me a little scare…

Original Text: ビビりにもどりたくないぜ…
Translated Text: I don't want to go back to being a scaredy-cat…

Original Text: びびって　【行動：こうどう】できなくなる
Translated Text: I get so scared that I can't bring myself to act
Phew, I've still got a long way to go.

Original Text: 【下級生物：かきゅうせいぶつ】が　【一丁前：いっちょうまえ】に…。\nなる…？　ともだち…？
Translated Text:
A lowly creature acting all grown-up…?
Is that even possible…? A friend…?

Original Text: ふぅ　まだまだだぜ
Translated Text: Phew... I've still got a long way to go.

Original Text: 【虫歯：むしば】にしてやろうか！
Translated Text: Should I give you a cavity?

Original Text: きれいな【歯：は】をしてやがる
【虫歯：むしば】が【痛：いた】くて　ＨＰがどんどん【減：へ】っていく
Translated Text: My toothache is so bad that my HP keeps dropping.

Original Text: ともだちになれ！　さもなくば\n【虫歯：むしば】にするぞ！！
Translated Text: Let's be friends! Or else\nI'll give you cavities!!

Original Text: 【歯医者：はいしゃ】に【行：い】くな…
ワシはビタ【一文払：いちもんはら】わんぞ
Translated Text: I'm not paying a single penny.

Original Text: ドケチの【何：なに】がわるい！
ぜいたくは【敵：てき】じゃ…
【最後：さいご】にケチが【勝：か】つ…
Translated Text: In the end, the cheapskate wins…

Original Text: ドケチになって　だれも【信用：しんよう】しなくなる
Translated Text: You'll become a cheapskate and stop trusting anyone.
I'm not giving it to you, meow!

Original Text: タダ【働：ばたら】きはゴメンじゃ
Translated Text: I'm not about to work for free.

Original Text: お【見事：みごと】　お【見事：みごと】…。　【一銭：いっせん】も【出：だ】せんが\nともだちになってやってもいいぞ。
Translated Text: Well done, well done… Even though I can’t\nspare a single sen, I’ll be your friend.

Original Text: タダ【働：はたら】きはゴメンじゃ
Translated Text: I'm not about to work for free.

Original Text: いい　ひまつぶしよ
Translated Text: That's a good way to kill time.

Original Text: 【闇：やみ】の【力：ちから】が【足：た】りぬ…
Translated Text: I don't have enough dark power...
I just can't take this seriously...

Original Text: 【闇：やみ】の【力：ちから】で　ＨＰがどんどん【減：へ】っていく
Translated Text: Under the influence of dark powers, my HP keeps dropping.

Original Text: お【前：まえ】からは【闇：やみ】の【力：ちから】を【感：かん】じる…。\n【気：き】に【入：い】ったぞ…。
Translated Text:
I sense the power of
darkness coming from you... I
like that...

Original Text: いつでも【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】だよ！

Translated Text: I have a bad feeling about this…

Original Text: 【大丈夫：だいじょうぶ】かなぁ…
Translated Text: I wonder if it'll be okay...

Original Text: 【幸運：こううん】パワーで　【全：ぜん】ステータスが【小：しょう】アップ
Translated Text: With Luck Power, all stats get a small boost

Original Text: きみ　すごいね～。\nいっしょにいたら【楽：たの】しそうだな～。
Translated Text:
You're amazing. It would
be so much fun to hang out
with you.

Original Text: ついに…　【出番：でばん】ですね
ようやく　【来：き】ましたね…

Translated Text: I think I can do it!

Original Text: 【私：わたし】はツチノコなのか…
パンダの【可愛：かわい】さにいやされ　ＨＰが【少：すこ】しずつ【回復：かいふく】
Translated Text: Soothed by the cuteness of pandas, my HP gradually recovers

Original Text: 【色々：いろいろ】さすらってきましたが　あなたは\n【最高：さいこう】です…。　ともだちになりましょう…。
Translated Text: I've been wandering around\nhere and there, but you're\nthe best... Let's be friends...

Original Text: あなたは　【強：つよ】いです！
ラッキーな【気分：きぶん】！

Translated Text: I just want to run away…
I really don't want to fight...

Original Text: 【幸運：こううん】パワーで　【全：ぜん】ステータスがアップ
Translated Text: All stats increase thanks to the power of luck

Original Text: きみと　ともだちになりたい。\nそして【福：ふく】を【運：はこ】んであげたい…。
Translated Text:
I want to be friends with you.
And I want to bring you good luck…

Original Text: りっぱな【龍：りゅう】になるのだ！
Translated Text: I'm going to become a magnificent dragon!

Original Text: どっかーん　なのだ！
お【昼寝：ひるね】したいのだ…
Translated Text: I just want to take a nap…
I just can't muster the strength...

Original Text: 【龍：りゅう】の【力：ちから】で　ちからがアップ
Translated Text: The Dragon's Power Boosts Your Strength
It's coming out of my armpit!
I'm getting all worked up, meow!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】　【気：き】に【入：い】ったのだ！\nともだちになるのだ！

Translated Text: We've got to get out of here!

Original Text: 【大地：だいち】の【力：ちから】を【見：み】よ！
Translated Text: Behold the power of the earth!

Original Text: あまり【期待：きたい】するな…
Translated Text: Don't get your hopes up too much...

Original Text: 【龍：りゅう】の【力：ちから】で　ちからがアップ
Translated Text: The Dragon's Power Boosts Your Strength
It's coming out of my armpit!
I'm getting all worked up, meow!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】の【力：ちから】　まことの【力：ちから】なり！\n【文句：もんく】はないぞ！
Translated Text:
Your power—that's true power!
I have no complaints!

Original Text: お【前：まえ】の【力：ちから】　【見事：みごと】なり！
【水：みず】に　【切：き】れぬものなし！
【敵：てき】など　ひとのみよ
【青龍：せいりゅう】の【力：ちから】で　ようりょくがアップ
Translated Text: With the power of the Azure Dragon, your strength increases.
It's coming out of my armpit!
I'm getting all worked up, meow!

Original Text: そなたは　すばらしい…。\n【絆：きずな】を【結：むす】ばせてはくれんか…？
Translated Text:
You are wonderful…
Would you let me form a
bond with you…?

Original Text: そなたは　すばらしい…

Translated Text: I really don't want to, though!

Original Text: ハリセンでたたいてやる
Translated Text: I'll hit you with a harisen.

Original Text: ボコボコにしてやるよぉ
Translated Text: I'm gonna beat the crap out of you!

Original Text: みんなをきらいになって　こうげきしてしまう
Translated Text: I end up hating everyone and attacking them.

Original Text: ともだちになってやるよー！\nお【前：まえ】なんか【嫌：きら】いだけどなー！
Translated Text:
I'll be your friend—even
though I really hate
you!

Original Text: 【一生：いっしょう】　ゆるさない！
すべてをにくしみ　こうげきしてしまう
Translated Text: I hate everything—and end up lashing out at it.

Original Text: 【負：ま】けたー！　ともだちになって\n【毎日：まいにち】うらんでやるー！
Translated Text: I lost! I'm going to be your\nfriend and curse you every day!
I don't want to do this...

Original Text: 【逆上：ぎゃくじょう】して　【味方：みかた】をこうげきしてしまう
Translated Text: In a fit of rage, they end up attacking their own allies.

Original Text: くっそ！　なんで【負：ま】けるんだよ！\n【認：みと】めねえぞ！　ともだちなれ！
Translated Text:
Damn it! Why did I lose?! I won't
accept this! Let's be friends!

Original Text: くっそ！　【認：みと】めねぇぞ…
Translated Text: Damn it! I'm not admitting it...
Let's grab a bite to eat on the way!
So I just have to do it, right?

Original Text: 【道草：みちくさ】は【最高：さいこう】だぜ！
Translated Text: Taking a detour is the best!

Original Text: 【道草：みちくさ】のジャマすんな！
Translated Text: Don't get in the way of my detour!
I really don't want to fight...

Original Text: 【道草：みちくさ】を　【食：く】って【行動：こうどう】しなくなる
Translated Text: They get sidetracked and stop taking action
Maybe I'll take a little detour...
I'm going to take a detour~
Maybe I'll take a little detour...
Maybe I'll take a little detour...
I'm going to take a little detour...

Original Text: いろいろ【道草：みちくさ】くってきたけど\nお【前：まえ】の【味：あじ】は【最高：さいこう】だぜ！
Translated Text: I've tried a lot of different things\nalong the way, but you're the best!

Original Text: 【道草：みちくさ】してりゃよかった…
Translated Text: I wish I'd just taken my time...

Original Text: これだから　トーシロはよ！
Translated Text: That's why you're such a rookie!

Original Text: トーシロ【以下：いか】の【敵：てき】だぜ！
オレって　【超：ちょう】スゲェ！
【普通：ふつう】のヤツしかいねぇ…
Translated Text: There's nothing but the usual crowd here...

Original Text: 【戦：たたか】いの【素人：しろうと】になって　ちからが【大：だい】ダウン
Translated Text: I've become a novice at fighting, and my strength has taken a huge hit.

Original Text: 【上手：うま】く【体：からだ】が【動：うご】かない…
Translated Text: My body just won't move right...

Original Text: 【上手：うま】く【動：うご】けんニャ…
Translated Text: I can't move very well, meow...

Original Text: お【前気：まえき】に【入：い】ったよ！\nなんかわかんないけど【気：き】に【入：い】ったよ！
Translated Text:
I really like you!
I don't know why, but I just do!

Original Text: もちろんオレのおごり！
【今：いま】　【楽：たの】しいのが【一番：いちばん】
Translated Text: Having fun right now is what matters most

Original Text: 【先：さき】のことは【考：かんが】えない…
Translated Text: I don't think about the future...

Original Text: むだづかいして　お【金：かね】をばらまく
Translated Text: Waste money and throw it around

Original Text: きみ　【金：かね】づかい【荒：あ】らそうだね…。\n【気：き】に【入：い】ったよ！
Translated Text:
You seem like you'd be
a bit of a spendthrift...
I like it!

Original Text: ごちそう【食：た】べようよ！
【気前：きまえ】がよくなって　お【金：かね】をばらまく
Translated Text: Becoming more generous and handing out money

Original Text: シェー　シェッシェ！\nともだちになるかーい？
ワイの【話：はなし】　【聞：き】きたいんか？
Translated Text: Do you want to hear my story?

Original Text: ワイと【語：かた】り【合：あ】おか！

Translated Text: Even though it's called a battle...

Original Text: ワイの【話：はなし】オモロイやろ？
【話：はなし】が【長：なが】くなって　すばやさがダウン
Translated Text: The story got too long, so my speed dropped.

Original Text: 【自分：じぶん】　なかなかやるやん！\nその【心意気：こころいき】　【気：き】にいったで！
Translated Text:
You're actually pretty good at this!
I really like that spirit!

Original Text: ムシがたかってきよる…

Translated Text: I'm going to slack off a bit~

Original Text: バナナのパワーで　すばやさがアップ
Translated Text: Boost Your Speed with the Power of Bananas

Original Text: ともだち　よろ！　【以上：いじょう】\n【話：はなし】が【短：みじか】いって？　ただのバナナやから！
Translated Text: Let's be friends! What do you\nmean the story's too short?\nIt's just a banana, after all!

Original Text: バトルをしきるんじゃ！
Translated Text: Let's take charge of the battle!

Original Text: しきり【放題：ほうだい】じゃー！

Translated Text: Don't just leave it to me...

Original Text: しきりすぎが　【反感：はんかん】を【買：か】い　ようりょくがダウン
Translated Text: Over-restriction has sparked resentment and caused a decline in morale.

Original Text: しきるんジャ～！\nともだちになるんジャ～！
Translated Text:
Let's rule the world! Let's
be friends!

Original Text: このバトル　【見：み】とどけよう！
Translated Text: Let's watch this battle to the end!

Original Text: 【堂々：どうどう】と【勝負：しょうぶ】じゃ！
【大一番：おおいちばん】じゃな！

Translated Text: You mean there's some kind of fraud...?

Original Text: まむしの【毒：どく】でしびれて　すばやさが【大：だい】ダウン
Translated Text: Numbed by the viper's venom, my speed drops drastically

Original Text: すばらしい【一戦：いっせん】！　まことに【見事：みごと】！\nともだちになってやろうぞ！
Translated Text:
What a great match! Truly impressive!
Let's be friends!

Original Text: フンッ！　いけそうじゃ
Translated Text: Hmph! I think I can do it.

Original Text: 【好調：こうちょう】じゃのう　プイッ！
Translated Text: Things are going well, aren't they? Pfft!

Original Text: すねてしまって　【近：ちか】くの【妖怪：ようかい】をこうげきする
Translated Text: I got sulky and attacked a nearby Yo-kai.

Original Text: フン！　やってられないぜ…。\nでも…。　ともだちになってやるよ…。
Translated Text:
Hmph! I can't deal with this...
But... I'll be your friend...

Original Text: どうにでもしろ！　プイッ！
【実力：じつりょく】を【見：み】せつけよう
Translated Text: Let's show what we're made of
I still have a long way to go...
This is going to be tough...

Original Text: オロチの【加護：かご】で　すばやさが【大：だい】アップ
Translated Text: With Orochi's blessing, Agility gets a huge boost

Original Text: いつもより【足：あし】が【動：うご】く！
Translated Text: My legs are moving better than usual!

Original Text: 【私：わたし】の【名：な】はオロチ…。\n【今日：きょう】から　お【前：まえ】のことを【守：まも】ろう。
Translated Text:
My name is Orochi...
Starting today, I'll protect you.

Original Text: 【影：かげ】の【存在：そんざい】になり　すばやさがアップ
Translated Text: Become a shadow and gain a speed boost
I'll just fade into the shadows...
I'm going to be a shadow...

Original Text: 【我：われ】は　【影：かげ】…。\nしかし…　ともだちがいてもいい…。
Translated Text:
I am a shadow...
But... it's okay to have friends...

Original Text: シャイニィィィングッ！
【聖：せい】なる【光：ひかり】で　ＨＰがどんどん【回復：かいふく】
Translated Text: With the Sacred Light, HP recovers rapidly

Original Text: お【前：まえ】　いい【輝：かがや】きをしているなッ！\n【今日：きょう】から　ともだちだッ！
Translated Text:
Man, you've got a great
glow about you! Starting
today, we're friends!
They'll take me down with their bare hands!

Original Text: 【真：ま】っ【二：ぷた】つにするニャン！
Translated Text: I'm gonna split it right down the middle, meow!

Original Text: なんという【不覚：ふかく】…
【武士：ぶし】の【心：こころ】で　ちからが【大：だい】アップ
Translated Text: With the Spirit of a Samurai, Your Strength Will Skyrocket

Original Text: ぶ　【武士：ぶし】の【情：なさ】け…
Translated Text: Well... the compassion of a samurai...

Original Text: それがし　ブシニャンでござる！\nお【主：ぬし】の　【友：とも】となるでござる！
Translated Text:
I am Bushinyan!
I shall be your friend!

Original Text: ぶ　【武士：ぶし】の【情：なさ】け…
Translated Text: Well... the compassion of a samurai...

Original Text: 【地獄：じごく】の【炎：ほのお】だぜ！

Translated Text: I'm gonna burn it all to the ground!

Original Text: しゅらの【力：ちから】で　ようりょくが【大：だい】アップ
Translated Text: Shura's power has greatly increased my strength.

Original Text: しゅらコマだぜ～！\nともだちなるぜ～！
Translated Text:
It's Shura Koma! Let's be
friends!
Even the battles are so cool!

Original Text: 【大声援：だいせいえん】が【聞：き】こえるね
Translated Text: I can hear the loud cheers.
That's not very pretty, is it…

Original Text: いやしのふんいきで　ＨＰがだんだん【回復：かいふく】
Translated Text: In this healing atmosphere, your HP gradually recovers.
I can't take it anymore, meow!
It's tough being a heartthrob, too...

Original Text: ワンダホー！　イケメンの【登場：とうじょう】さ！\n【夢中：むちゅう】にさせて　あげるよ！
Translated Text:
Wonderful! Here comes a hottie!
I'm going to make you fall head over heels!
It's tough being a heartthrob, too...

Original Text: ハッピー　ハッピー
【桜満開：さくらまんかい】　すばやさが【大：だい】アップ
Translated Text: Cherry Blossoms in Full Bloom: Speed Greatly Increased

Original Text: わしといっしょに\nこの【町：まち】を【花：はな】でいっぱいにせんか？
Translated Text: Why don't you join me in\nfilling this town with flowers?

Original Text: これぞ　【極：きわ】めし【力：ちから】！
【鬼：おに】の【力：ちから】で　まもりが【大：だい】アップ
Translated Text: With the power of the demon, defense gets a huge boost

Original Text: 【我：われ】は【鬼：おに】！\nお【前：まえ】はともだち！
Translated Text:
I'm a demon!
